title: Mental Health Self-Assessment Scale
short: This tool can help an individual reflect on their mental health and behaviors.

intro.measures: This tool can help an individual reflect on their mental health and behaviors. This mental health assessment questionnaire helps evaluate a person’s overall mental health.
intro.instructions: Each question can be answered on a scale from 0 to 4. This scale is for self-reflection or a general assessment and is not a substitute for professional diagnosis or evaluation.

questions.title: General Mental Health
questions.text: How would you rate your overall mental health?

questions.title: Sleep, Appetite, and Libido
questions.text: How often do you experience problems with your sleep, appetite, or libido?

questions.title: Mood
questions.text: How often do you experience mood swings or feel that your mood is not stable?

questions.title: Socialization and Social Interaction
questions.text: How satisfied are you with your level of socialization and social interactions?

questions.title: Feelings of Fear or Insecurity
questions.text: How often do you feel fearful or insecure, as if someone might be talking about you?

questions.title: Anxiety and Avoidance
questions.text: How often do you feel anxious or avoid doing things that most people do normally?

questions.title: Repetitive Behaviors
questions.text: How often do you find yourself doing things repeatedly or checking things repeatedly against your wishes?

questions.title: Feeling Misfit
questions.text: How often do you feel like a misfit in society or in the current scenario?

questions.title: Substance Use
questions.text: How often do you consume any substance excessively, leading to conflict with family, hindrance in personal growth, health issues, or occupational problems?

questions.title: Memory and Confusion
questions.text: How often do you forget things more than previously, or get confused about time, place, and person?

bands.label: Low level of concern
bands.text: Your responses suggest you might not be experiencing significant issues in the areas assessed.

bands.label: Mild level of concern
bands.text: You may be experiencing some difficulties in a few areas.

bands.label: Moderate level of concern
bands.text: Your responses suggest noticeable difficulties in several areas that may require attention.

bands.label: High level of concern
bands.text: It appears you are experiencing significant issues in many areas assessed. Seeking professional advice might be beneficial.

note: Remember, this scale is a general tool for self-assessment and not a professional diagnosis. If you are experiencing distress or significant problems in your daily life, consider reaching out to a mental health professional for a comprehensive evaluation and support.
